# Hotel Agava — Tbilisi, Georgia

> A 21-room hotel in Dighomi, Tbilisi, at 161 Akaki Beliashvili Street. Family
> rooms for three to five guests, two rooms with a private jacuzzi, free parking
> in the hotel courtyard, free Wi-Fi, a lift serving all four floors and a
> reception staffed around the clock. Rated 4.8 on Google from 355 reviews.

## Facts

- Address: 161 Akaki Beliashvili Street, Dighomi, Didube district, Tbilisi, Georgia
- Phone: +995 597 12 12 12 · Email: agavahoteltbilisi@gmail.com
- Reception: open 24/7, with a person on the desk at night; staff speak English, Russian and Turkish
- Check-in from 13:00, check-out by 12:00. Early check-in and late check-out are charged
- Payment is taken at the hotel, in cash only. Cards are not accepted and there is no online prepayment
- 21 rooms in 8 types, 120–400 GEL per night
- Breakfast: 30 GEL per guest, buffet from 08:00 to 11:00, not included in the room price
- Parking: free for guests, 11 spaces in the hotel courtyard, which also has a small seating area
- Airport transfer: 70 GEL from the airport, 50 GEL to the airport, per car with four seats, 30–40 minutes
- Laundry: 10 GEL per item, ready in 12 hours
- Smoking is not allowed in the rooms; guests can smoke in the covered part of the courtyard. There is no fine
- No extra beds are added in any room: the room is chosen by the number of guests
- The hotel has no restaurant, swimming pool, spa, gym, conference room, luggage room or currency exchange
- US Embassy about 800 m away on foot; Tbilisi International Airport about 23 km

## Rooms

- [Standard room](https://hotelagava.ge/en/rooms/standard/) — 22 m², 2 guests, 120 GEL
- [Deluxe room](https://hotelagava.ge/en/rooms/lux/) — 28 m², 2 guests, 250 GEL
- [Superior suite](https://hotelagava.ge/en/rooms/superlux/) — 36 m², 2 guests, 300 GEL
- [Family room for 3](https://hotelagava.ge/en/rooms/family3/) — 32 m², 3 guests, 150 GEL
- [Family room for 4](https://hotelagava.ge/en/rooms/family4/) — 38 m², 4 guests, 250 GEL
- [Two-room suite](https://hotelagava.ge/en/rooms/twobedlux/) — 45 m², 5 guests, two separate rooms, 200 GEL
- [Jacuzzi Suite](https://hotelagava.ge/en/rooms/jacuzzi-suite/) — 30 m², 2 guests, private jacuzzi, city view, 300 GEL
- [Super suite with jacuzzi](https://hotelagava.ge/en/rooms/jacuzzi/) — 2 guests, private jacuzzi, King bed, 400 GEL
